verdict.rationale: Docs describe self-hosting the SDK's orchestration layer (Docker/Kubernetes, subprocess architecture, session persistence) via claude-agent-sdk-docs-11/20, suggesting infra portability, but the SDK still requires calling Anthropic's Claude models/API and is subject to Anthropic's platform policies. Community evidence directly contradicts 'no vendor dependence': Anthropic changed subscription terms so SDK-based apps can no longer use Claude subscriptions and must pay via API, effectively 'forcing people to use their garbage harness' with policy uncertainty and risk of being cut off, showing real vendor lock-in despite self-hosting docs (claude-agent-sdk-comm-1, comm-3, comm-4, comm-5, comm-9, comm-11). Missing for 10: evidence of running without any Anthropic API/model dependency, clarity on policy stability, and independent confirmation that self-hosted deployments are free of vendor control.
